body_markdown:
BW LPG is proud to be part of BW Group who has achieved a place again on Forbes’ World’s Best Employers list. This marks BW’s third appearance on the list, climbing 160 places globally and now ranking third among Singapore companies featured.


“Our people bring our CARE values to life, at sea and ashore. These values guide how we work together, listen to one another and support our colleagues’ growth. This recognition celebrates everyone’s commitment and reminds us to keep building a workplace where everyone feels respected, safe and able to contribute.” – Kristian Sørensen, CEO of BW LPG.


For our seafarers, our Zero Harm culture support safe operations, while talent contests create opportunities to share their creativity and connect across our fleet. We also support future maritime talent through BW LPG India’s Female Cadets Scholarship Programme, which sponsored 33 cadets in 2025.


For our shore colleagues, workshops, ‘Lunch & Learn’ sessions and leadership development support continued learning and development. Open communication and employee feedback help us improve the workplace, while engagement and well-being activities bring colleagues together and ensure physical, mental and social health.


Across our fleet and offices, programmes such as ‘Respect and Belonging at Sea’ as well as ‘Zero Harm’ encourages everyone to speak up, look out for one another and take personal responsibility for safety as well as inclusion and belonging.


Adrian Lau, Global HR Director at BW LPG: “Our people are at the heart of everything we do. Whether at sea or ashore, across our global offices and fleet operations, our teams work together every day to safely deliver energy to communities around the world while driving continuous improvement and innovation in our industry. Thank you to our colleagues for the part you play every day in making BW LPG a great place to work!”


Explore the Forbes World’s Best Employers 2026 list:[https://www.forbes.com/lists/worlds-best-employers/](https://www.forbes.com/lists/worlds-best-employers/)
